description: This file declares utility functions for environment variable management within the c10::utils namespace, including setting variables, checking if they are set, interpreting their boolean value, and retrieving their string value.

methods.name: set_env
methods.description: Sets an environment variable with the specified name and value, with an option to overwrite existing value.

methods.name: has_env
methods.description: Checks if an environment variable is set.

methods.name: check_env
methods.description: Reads an environment variable, interprets its value as a boolean flag ('1' or '0'), and issues a warning if the value is not 0 or 1. Returns an optional<bool>.

methods.name: get_env
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable as an optional<string>.
